purpose: Teach: 辻/ぃ/にゃ/かぁ/るる/之/燭/頁

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、辻角のお店との比較を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer mentioned how your coffee compared to the place on the corner.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Mei noticing something small and true. Gentle cadence, like sharing a remembered detail across a quiet counter.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「ねぇ、これ美味しぃ」って小さく仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer told you quietly that the drink was delicious.
lines.style: Soft amusement in the voice. Aoi catching the genuine compliment underneath the hesitation. Half-smile in the delivery, almost conspiratorial.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ペットの猫が「にゃ」って鳴く動画を見せて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer showed you a video of their cat meowing.
lines.style: Gently wry, almost tender. Mei finding something unexpectedly charming in the ordinariness. A small pause before 'meowing' — letting the cuteness land.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「そっかぁ、それはいい」って優しく頷いて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer nodded gently and said, 'I see — that's nice.'
lines.style: Quiet warmth, almost wondering. Aoi's voice carrying the weight of someone noticing kindness in a small gesture. Slight exhale before speaking.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様が「るるる」って歌を口ずさんでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer's child was humming a little tune.
lines.style: Soft recognition in the voice. Mei noticing the small, unguarded moment of a child. Gentle pace, like she's holding the memory carefully.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、書道家、つまり「之を書く」専門家でいらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer was a calligrapher — someone who specializes in writing.
lines.style: Straightforward but not flat. Aoi sharing a discovered fact with quiet interest. Even tone, slight lift on 'calligrapher' with genuine recognition.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お盆の燭、つまり蝋燭を手に入れた事を話して下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer mentioned picking up candles for Obon.
lines.style: Reflective warmth. Mei speaking of something seasonal and intentional. Steady pace, respectful of the detail. A pause held before 'candles.'

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、メニューの最後の頁を読まれてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer was reading the last page of the menu.
lines.style: Gentle observation trailing into softness. Aoi noticing something quiet and solitary. Slight slowness, as if Mei is watching someone absorbed in their own small world.
